lines.text: Agent Forty. Nice to meet you. I’m Q.
I might have guessed. Do you normally look like a letter Q?
You should be seeing me as a hip giglio grandpa with doc Brown hair. If I look like a Q, your Q-lens could be malfunctioning.
We installed a Q contact lens in your eye. I’ll sneak into your apartment again tonight and make some adjustments. No worries, you won’t even know I was there.

Oh, I hope you don’t mind. You were fast asleep after watching the 2006 SPIKE VGA’s twice back to back. I couldn’t wake you if I tried. Couldn’t get a wink of sleep myself inside your couch - you were snoring so loud...
...Must echo off that head of yours I would imagine. So I thought why not install the lens and save some time.
It’s totally fine - Gadgets you know - Science - I’m a geek - It’s a whole thing. The supercomputer places your chances of complaining at 0.1%. So I’d say we’re in the clear.
Well, I’m one to test the odds, I don’t suppose you have a gadget around here that points toward the HR department?
Your file said you were a joker. I could easily whip out up, but no need. HR watches everything through the lens already.
Well they did tune out for most of the VGA’s. 2006 was a different time...
Well look at the time, I’m running late for my briefing with MoneyPony.
Of course! She’s over there by the briefing screen - I’ve engineered the screen to double as a salt lick!
